reputation.title: Crew reputation
reputation.desc: The reputation score is calculated from customer reviews and the outcome of repair orders.
reputation.need: At least {orders} valid orders and {reviews} reviews are required before a score is published.
reputation.formula: Score = S × 0.50 + C × 0.25 + T × 0.15 + Q × 0.10. Each part is on a 0–10 scale.
reputation.reviewsHelp: Average stars on valid orders. With few reviews the score is pulled toward 3.5 stars before it is converted to a 10-point scale, so one 5-star review is not worth 10.
reputation.completionHelp: Completed orders divided by completed orders plus orders the crew cancelled. A customer cancellation is left out of the denominator and does not lower the score by itself.
reputation.onTimeHelp: The agreed deadline is the order date plus the days on the accepted quotation. A job finished after that deadline is late. Orders without a deadline or a finish time stay out of the denominator.
reputation.complaintsHelp: Only admin-decided complaints on valid orders count. A rejected complaint counts as handled in the crew's favour. An upheld complaint lowers the rate. Open complaints are excluded. With no decision yet, the component stays at a neutral 5/10 instead of 100%.
reputation.metricInsufficient: Not enough data for this figure
reputation.customerCancelled: {n} customer cancellations, excluded from the completion rate
reputation.storeDesc: The reputation score is calculated from customer reviews and the outcome of material orders.
reputation.storeCompletionHelp: Received orders divided by that number plus orders the store cancelled because it could not fulfill them. A valid cancellation by the customer is left out of the denominator and does not lower the score.
reputation.storeOnTimeHelp: Only delivered orders with a confirmed expected delivery time are counted. Delivery after that time is late. Orders without a confirmed time stay out of the denominator.
reputation.storeComplaintsHelp: Each order counts one incident, using the latest handling status. An accepted complaint or return lowers the rate. A rejected case counts as handled correctly. Open cases are not counted yet. With no concluded case, the system uses a neutral 5/10 instead of a perfect score.
reputation.shortfall: Still need {orders} valid orders and {reviews} reviews.
reputation.autoNote: BuildMate calculates the reputation score automatically from valid transactions.
